business_problem: Longshine Group wanted an electricity-industry large model that could answer policy questions, interpret power bills, and support data Q&A for utilities and enterprise energy customers. The company needed a way to adapt a foundation model to highly specialized electricity knowledge, transaction language, and billing workflows while keeping service quality high enough for customer-facing use.
solution_summary: Longshine Group built its electricity-domain large model on Alibaba Cloud Bailian using Qwen as the foundation model and years of power- industry knowledge as tuning material. The implementation started with scenario-level validation, then moved into POC work and later iterative optimization over industry Q&A data, NL2SQL for data-questioning scenarios, plugin-side API enhancements, and multi-turn bill- interpretation prompts plus SFT data. That process produced not just a domain model but also customer-facing applications for electricity policy Q&A, bill interpretation, and data inquiry. In operation, Bailian handles fine-tuning, deployment, and evaluation, while the resulting electricity model orchestrates business strategies and supports more intelligent service experiences for utility and enterprise users. The design turns Longshine's accumulated sector corpus into a reusable energy-service intelligence layer rather than isolated prompt experiments.

solution_components.role: Serves as the foundation model adapted into Longshine's electricity-industry large model.

solution_components.name: Electricity industry large model
solution_components.role: Delivers domain reasoning for policy Q&A, bill interpretation, and data-questioning services.

data_flow: Longshine's electricity-domain corpora and scenario data are used in Bailian to tune Qwen for policy interpretation, bill analysis, and data question answering. Those model outputs are then served into energy-service applications that support utility and enterprise customers with domain-specific responses and workflow guidance.
business_outcome: Longshine turned years of electricity-domain expertise into a reusable large-model service layer. In testing, the electricity bill AI interpretation application improved service interaction efficiency by more than 50% and cut manual ticket handling by more than 70%, while the broader domain model gave Longshine a path to more intelligent energy services for 12,000+ enterprise customers and 460+ million households.
